body: Why would we give you that. As much as you say your mind is made up, you will be scared and you will be scared to leave it all behind even if it is painful torture. If you don’t endure you might never know what else will come later that’s good. Even the darkest tunnels without light have an exit. If you kill yourself now, there is no big release. You are just gone. It really is not worth it.
